title: The report hides money but not line text from a user without financial access
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as user B, whose role has Reports and Invoicing & payments - View on and See financial data off, at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Make sure Require Tech Story is on (click the location box at the top right, then Settings; on the Work Orders tab, under LINE REQUIREMENTS, set the Require Tech Story switch, then click Save Settings. The setting covers every location, so check it before each test).
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with one labor line, line 1, titled "Replace tie rod" with the description "Excessive play". To make it: go to Work Orders and click Create Work Order: pick a Customer (for example 4 Star Truck Repair) and an asset under Add Asset (for example 2015 Ford Escape), then click Save; if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create. The new work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line window already open; in the New Line window type the title in the Title box (press Tab to leave the list of canned lines without picking one), type the description, if any, in the Description box, type 1 in Estimated Time, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close (for another line, click New Line again).
  • Have line 1 completed with the tech story "Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned", and work order 1 completed and invoiced today as invoice A, by an Admin. To do this on work order 1's Lines tab: for a line that needs a tech story, click Add tech story for this line under it, type the tech story and click Update; click Complete in each line's Action column (once every line is complete, work order 1 shows Complete by itself); then click the Finance tab, then Create Invoice, and close the New Customer Payment window with its X. The invoice number shows on the Finance tab as Invoice: INV-…
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Start with the Export Report dialog open: click Reports in the top bar, then Export Reports under ACCOUNTING in the Reports left menu.
custom_steps:
1. Pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  2. Pick Today in the Date Range list.
  3. Click Export.
  4. Open the downloaded file in Google Sheets.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer Invoice is picked in Report Name.

Step 2:

  • The date range shows today's date.

Step 3:

  • A Customer Invoice file downloads.

Step 4:

  • In line 1's row (work order 1's invoice A) the ItemDescription cell reads exactly "Replace tie rod - Excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned".
  • The line text is not masked: user B reads the same words an Admin reads.
  • On the same row the ItemRate, ItemAmount and ItemTaxAmount cells read "Restricted" instead of an amount, and the average cost cell shows no amount.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-R10: “For a user who cannot see financial data, the downloaded report masks its money columns (rate, amount, tax and average cost) as it does today. The line text is not a money value and is not masked, so the same words reach every reader of the file.”
  • Story 3, Prerequisites: “Downloading the report requires Invoicing & payments - View. The gate is enforced on the server, not by hiding the entry in the Export Reports dialog.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-11257, and bug SV-11850 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10132, Nemanja Djuric, 8 Oct 2026 (Ready for QA testing): “The same export as a user without "See financial data": the line text is identical and ItemRate / ItemAmount / ItemTaxAmount read "Restricted".”

Last checked against build v26.43.1-f2d183d (staging) on 10/28/2026.
